sources.entry: Dropzone - Create a popup grid of customizable actions. Scriptable in Ruby & Python.

summary.name: Dropzone 5
summary.one_liner: Dropzone 5 is a Mac app that puts a popup grid of customizable drag-and-drop actions at the top of the screen for moving, copying, sharing, uploading and launching files and apps.
use_cases: Move or copy files by dragging them onto a grid action
Upload files or screenshots to SFTP, Amazon S3 or Imgur
Resize or compress images in bulk from a drop
Download videos from YouTube and similar sites
Automate file workflows from the terminal or scripts
Keep the desktop tidy by temporarily holding files in Drop Bar
summary.what_it_does: Dropzone is a Mac app that shows a grid of actions when you drag a file, and you drop files onto an action to move, copy, share, upload or process them. Dropzone 5 adds multiple grids that can be switched quickly, adjustable column counts and grid sizing, and folder-based actions that show custom Finder folder icons and colors. Drop Bar is a holding area for files that can be dragged out to other apps or actions. The dz command line tool lets users run actions, add files to Drop Bar and switch grids from the terminal. Keyboard shortcuts (F3 by default or a custom one) open the grid from any app.
notable: Multiple customizable action grids with a dz command line tool for scripting
Drop Bar for temporarily holding files
Folder actions display custom macOS Tahoe folder icons and colors
Add-on Actions installable within the app, and custom actions can be developed
caveats: Page says a free version exists, but the full feature set and which features are paid are not detailed on the page
Liquid Glass and folder icon support depend on macOS Tahoe
